text:
emily_csm: FYI 14-day rolling tokens for CerebrumRx are down ~92% vs baseline. Renewal in 14 days. Their product team says "integration flaky" and legal is pressuring them to run a short bakeoff with NimbusAI. Champion (Tom) left last sprint. Need rapid triage + retention playbook.

analytics-bot: Alert: customer=CerebrumRx, metric=tokens_14d, change=-92%, seats=10->2, err_rate=0.4%->5.8%, last_deploy=2026-03-02, key_changes=1 on 2026-03-15. Link: https://redwood.app/customers/cerebrumrx/health

jasper_am: Oof. I was on a procurement thread yesterday; they got a "low-cost latency" pitch from Nimbus. Price matters but PM said "we couldn't get dependable responses this week". Jasper -> I'll own the commercial outreach.

mina_onboard: Can we confirm whether they're hitting 401/403s or 5xxs? If it's auth we can fix quickly; if it's 5xx rollout bug, need eng.

analytics-bot: Breakdown (last 7d): 5xx=62%, 429=8%, 401/403=30%. Peak 5xx window 2026-03-18 02:00-05:00 UTC. Top api_key last active 2026-03-16.

derek_eng: I'll take the 5xx signature. Quick suspects: malformed header from client, payload size spike from recent dataset changes, or route to a quantized variant that regressed. Anyone got sample request ids or error payloads?

emily_csm: I can ask their PM for 3 failed request ids during the call. Meeting with their PM scheduled in 30m.

jasper_am: I'll lead the call and surface a short-term commercial gesture: two-week dedicated trial (no contract) or a credit to keep throughput while they test Nimbus. Need approval from finance for unilateral credit. tagging @finance-bot

finance-bot: Please include estimated $ value and proposed guardrails. Auto-note: approvals needed for credits > $5k.

mina_onboard: Suggested immediate steps: 1) enable debug logging for their account, 2) check if they switched to the sandbox endpoint (we saw this pattern before), 3) offer a 30-min live pairing session to walk their integrators through.

derek_eng: Quick dig: I correlated logs for 2026-03-18 and found amplified request payloads (avg tokens per call jumped from 420 to 15k) causing memory pressure and 502s in the router. Also found two IPs that used a deprecated header X-Client-Env which our gateway treats as large metadata and triggers path fallback.

emily_csm: On call now 1: their PM confirmed a pipeline change last week that increased sample sizes, and said their infra accidentally pointed to our "preview" endpoint during rollout. They gave three ids: req_20260318_bad1, req_20260318_bad2, req_20260319_bad3. Sending to @derek_eng and @mina_onboard.

derek_eng: Received ids. Triage: req_20260318_bad1 -> 502 (memory spike on instance), req_20260318_bad2 -> 502 (same), req_20260319_bad3 -> 401 (old api key). Root cause: combined payload spike + partial key rotation + preview endpoint misroute.

mina_onboard: Immediate mitigation: 1) we can temporarily reject payloads > 5k tokens with a clear error so their integrator can throttle; 2) whitelist their PM's IP for a temporary higher payload window during a paired session; 3) offer live pairing now to roll back to stable payloads.

jasper_am: Commercial ask from PM: can you guarantee throughput for a 2-week test? They want something signed by legal if possible. I'll propose a unilateral goodwill dedicated window (no contract) and follow up with an amendment if needed.

finance-bot: Quick calc: estimated cost of 2-week dedicated burst at 3x baseline = ~$6,200. Needs approval from Finance manager. Tagging @finance-team.

emily_csm: I'll log the renewal risk tag and push a one-pager to the customer: what happened, short-term mitigations, proposed 2-week dedicated trial, and next steps for a stability workshop.

derek_eng: I'll schedule a 45-min debug session with their SREs and run a temporary config change to reduce memory pressure (limit concurrent big payloads to 4, enable backpressure). Will monitor for 2-4 hours post-change.

(later) analytics-bot: Interim snapshot 4h later: tokens/day partially recovered to 68% of baseline after IP whitelist + config change; 5xx rate down to 1.2%; 401s resolved after key reconciliation; seats stable.

jasper_am: Finance approved a $6.2k unilateral credit for the burst. Sent written confirmation to CerebrumRx PM with dates and throughput cap. They accepted and paused Nimbus pilot for now.

mina_onboard: Follow-up action items: 
- emily_csm: update CS playbook + renewal cadence (due: EOD)
- jasper_am: share signed email confirmation + credit summary (done)
- derek_eng: monitor telemetry & rollback thresholds (ongoing)
- finance-bot: invoice adjustment queue (due: next billing cycle)

emily_csm: I'll set a 7-day check-in with their PM and schedule a QBR to re-establish champion relationships. Adding this to the renewal runbook.

analytics-bot: Final snapshot 24h later: tokens/day at 92% baseline, error rate 0.5%, active seats restored. Thread will be closed after QBR scheduling confirmed.
